q: Which section number of RFC 8446 carries the heading 'Record Padding'? Answer with the section number.

graph.query: MATCH (s:Section) WHERE toLower(s.title) = 'record padding' RETURN s.number ORDER BY s.number

q: Which section number of RFC 8446 carries the heading 'Hello Retry Request'? Answer with the section number.

graph.query: MATCH (s:Section) WHERE toLower(s.title) = 'hello retry request' RETURN s.number ORDER BY s.number

q: Which is the latest revision of draft-ietf-tls-tls13 in the datatracker? Answer with the draft revision id.

graph.query: MATCH (d:Draft {id:'draft-ietf-tls-tls13'})-[:HAS_REVISION]->(r:DraftRevision) RETURN r.id ORDER BY r.rev DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which RFC did draft-ietf-tls-tls13 become? Answer with the RFC id.

graph.query: MATCH (d:Draft {id:'draft-ietf-tls-tls13'})-[:HAS_REVISION]->(:DraftRevision)-[:BECAME]->(rfc:RFC) RETURN DISTINCT rfc.id ORDER BY rfc.id

q: Which revision ids of draft-ietf-tls-tls13 does the datatracker list from revision -18 to -28 inclusive? Answer with the draft revision ids.

graph.query: MATCH (d:Draft {id:'draft-ietf-tls-tls13'})-[:HAS_REVISION]->(r:DraftRevision) WHERE toInteger(r.rev) >= 18 AND toInteger(r.rev) <= 28 RETURN r.id ORDER BY r.rev

q: Which people does the datatracker record as chairs of the TLS working group? Answer with their names.

graph.query: MATCH (c:Chair) RETURN c.name ORDER BY c.name

q: Which thread ids are named by an archive subject that mentions draft-ietf-tls-tls13-21? Answer with the thread ids.
source: mailarchive browse pages, /arch/browse/tls/ (per-row subject and thread columns)

graph.query: MATCH (t:Thread)<-[:IN_THREAD]-(m:Message) WHERE m.subject CONTAINS 'draft-ietf-tls-tls13-21' RETURN DISTINCT t.id ORDER BY t.id
